ultimatescaler.config.server.publicTerra: Public terrain coordinates to other players
ultimatescaler.config.tweaks.expandDatap: Expand the range of literal values in datapacks

In datapacks, many density function options have value ranges that are limited, such as the range of constant terms.
Enabling this option will remove these restrictions.
ultimatescaler.config.tweaks.expandWorld: Removes the air walls at 30000000 and removes the limits of commands like /tp and /worldborder.
ultimatescaler.config.tweaks.fixChunkGen: Fix crash when generating chunks out of reasonable bounds

From 1.21.2, when generating chunks out of reasonable bounds (x/z beyond ±33552992), the game will crash.
The exception thrown is: IllegalStateException("Trying to create chunk out of reasonable bounds: " + pos)
This is obviously a human restriction.
ultimatescaler.config.tweaks.fixMineshaf: Fix crash when generating mineshafts at extreme coordinates
Due to integer overflow, when generating mineshafts at extreme coordinates (X/Z beyond ±1073741824), the game will crash. Enabling this option will extend the range to ±2147483647.
ultimatescaler.config.version_comment: The version of the configuration file, do not modify this value manually.
ultimatescaler.config.worldgen.FarLandsP: Custom the position of the Far lands by modifying the divisor in the MaintainPrecision method (default: 33554432).
Removed the Far lands, but the terrain stops generating at an extreme far distance (~1.05e+306).
ultimatescaler.config.worldgen.bigIntege: Rewriting the terrain generation using BigInteger, allows for more precise terrain offsetting in a wider range.
may cause the terrain generation to be much slower and consume more memory.
ultimatescaler.config.worldgen.experimen: Warning: Experimental features, unstable and may cause crashes or other issues.
ultimatescaler.config.worldgen.extraYOff:
Offset more factors that affect the Y-axis, enabling it can get more reasonable Y-axis terrain.
Note that when this option is enabled, all the far lands of the Y-axis will not generate without modifying the terrain generation algorithm.
ultimatescaler.config.worldgen.fixEndRin:
In vanilla Minecraft, due to integer overflow, the terrain of the End will be missing in several circular regions centered at the world origin (MC-159283), which are called "End Rings".
Enabling this option will fix this issue.

ultimatescaler.config.worldgen.maintainP: Note: Too large or too small values can cause problems with terrain generation, and the recommended range is 512~4294967295.
ultimatescaler.config.worldgen.maxNoiseL: Max return value of the method (10^n)
Setting to a specific value can remove the Fringe lands.
ultimatescaler.config.worldgen.replaceDe: Replace any dimension's default fluid (overworld: water; nether: lava; end: air) with the specified block.
ultimatescaler.config.worldgen.replaceUn: Replace the underground lava (Y<-54) in the overworld with the specified block (not necessarily effective).
